backend.description: Object storage backend for Mimir, Loki and Tempo. Required when Mimir, Loki or Tempo is enabled. No default. The objectStorage.validate helper fails the render while it is unset.

existingSecret.description: Fixed name. The Mimir, Loki and Tempo values reference this Secret from static values. Create the credentials Secret with this name. It holds `AZURE_STORAGE_KEY` for backend `azure`, or `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` for backend `s3`.

azure.$comment: accountName is required only when Mimir, Loki or Tempo is enabled, and conflicts with localObjectStorage.enabled, as connectionString does. Tempo also rejects connectionString outside localObjectStorage. Both depend on sibling values, so those checks live in the objectStorage.validate helper instead.

connectionString.description: Full Azure Blob connection string, overriding the endpoint derived from accountName. It embeds the account key and travels in a ConfigMap rather than the credentials Secret, so it is for emulators and development endpoints, not a real storage account. Set localObjectStorage.enabled instead to have it computed for a local Azurite.

store.description: aws or compatible. Picks Loki's storage client only: Loki thanos mode for compatible, Loki's default client for aws. Required with backend s3. No default. The objectStorage.validate helper fails the render while it is unset.

endpoint.description: Store endpoint, host[:port], no scheme. Required with backend s3. The objectStorage.validate helper fails the render while it is empty.

defaultOrganization.description: The GrafanaOrganization that takes over Grafana's org 1 ("Main Org.") with datasources reading the tenant set in global.tenant.

defaultAlertmanagerConfig.description: The Alertmanager config Secret for the tenant set in global.tenant, rendered from files/alertmanager.

localObjectStorage.description: Local object store instead of a real one: Azurite, the Azure Storage emulator, with backend azure, or Garage with backend s3. Development only - see doc/LOCAL_DEV.md.
